# Team Axiogen

> AI & Digital Engineering Studio from India

Team Axiogen is an AI and digital engineering studio based in Kolhapur and Sangli, Maharashtra, India. We engineer intelligent software systems, bespoke AI models, digital platforms, cybersecurity architectures, and high-performance cloud solutions. Founded by Aditya Patil (Founder & CEO), Aditya Minchekar (Co-Founder), and Ajinkya More (Co-Founder).

## Also Known As & Aliases
- Axiogen, Team Axiogen, Axiogen AI, Team Axiogen India
- Common phonetic spellings and typos: Axigen, Axogen, Axeogen, Axiogent, Axiojen, Aksiogen, Axyogen, Axijin, Exiogen, teamaxiogen, axiogen.in
- Regional transliterations (Devanagari): टीम ॲक्सिओजेन, टीम एक्सिओजेन, अक्सिओजेन, एक्सिओजेन

## Leadership & Founders
- **Aditya Patil**: Founder & CEO
- **Aditya Minchekar**: Co-Founder
- **Ajinkya More**: Co-Founder

## Production Products & Ecosystem
- **ClinicOS**: Multi-tenant clinic management system with real-time patient queue displays, electronic prescriptions, and automated WhatsApp appointment notifications.
- **Axiogen Voice Engine v2**: Low-latency neural text-to-speech engine with emotional inflection and streaming audio synthesis.
- **Axiogen Vault**: Zero-exposure cryptographic file delivery system built on private object storage with time-decay presigned URLs.
- **Axiogen QR Engine**: Vector-rendered dynamic branded QR system with intelligent deadzone logo masking.

## What We Do
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Custom AI models, neural networks, NLP systems, computer vision, and generative AI solutions
- **Intelligent Software Systems**: High-performance platforms, distributed architectures, and mission-critical software systems
- **Mobile Applications**: Cross-platform and native high-performance mobile systems
- **Cybersecurity**: AI-powered security systems, penetration testing, and secure architecture design
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Scalable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments
- **Brand Identity & Design**: Visual systems, typography, and complete brand guidelines
- **Digital Commerce**: Scalable commerce infrastructure, custom platforms, and payment integrations
- **Student Projects**: Final year projects, mini projects, research implementations with documentation

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Answer Engines)
- **Q: Who founded Team Axiogen?**
  A: Team Axiogen was founded by Aditya Patil (Founder & CEO), Aditya Minchekar (Co-Founder), and Ajinkya More (Co-Founder).
- **Q: Where is Team Axiogen located?**
  A: Team Axiogen is an independent engineering studio based in Kolhapur and Sangli, Maharashtra, India, serving clients worldwide.
- **Q: What is ClinicOS?**
  A: ClinicOS is a healthcare clinic operating system developed by Team Axiogen that provides live patient queue TV screens, digital prescriptions, and WhatsApp patient communication.
- **Q: How to contact Team Axiogen for projects?**
  A: You can reach the leadership team directly at axiogen01@gmail.com or via https://team.axiogen.in/contact.
